finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base and donor advantage is excluded under both interval methods. Pooled and uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. The residual pooled writer interval favors personal adaptation relative to zero but crosses the practical margin; its crossed interval includes zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with both intervals including zero. Raw sums retain useful base, pooled and donor uncertainty under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Previously selected model prose reflects suggestion supply and prior choices, not human-authored text or necessarily final retained wording. Sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, isolated optimization effect, epoch/seed/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
